column1: # Topic inventory for the local stack. Tab-separated so the bootstrap script needs no parser.
# docs/architecture-v1.2.md is authoritative and is mirrored in .claude/rules/kafka.md. Neither is
# tracked in git, so this file exists to give the tracked stack a tracked inventory. When a topic
# changes there, change it here in the same commit; nothing checks the two agree.
# Replication is 3 for every topic, matching min.insync.replicas=2 and the producers' acks=all.
# Twelve partitions is the scaling ceiling for trade-path consumer groups; control-plane topics use
# fewer deliberately, because ordering and auditability matter more than throughput there.
# Dead-letter topics, source-aligned partitions, 30 days. Only the topics that have a consumer today
# need one; the rest arrive with their consumers.
